tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du thugs rje chen po bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying gi nang du/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hrīḥdakar po las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ spyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil gyi bar gyi lus thams cad yongs su gang*/ sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ phar 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus nas rang la thim pas/ rang nyid thugs rje chen por gyur ba ni/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis sangs rgyas thams cad la thal mo sbyar nas/ sems can gyi don la bskul ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas phreng ba dkar po dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas rin po che dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas klubs pa/ rab tu zhi zhing gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ spyi bor 'od dpag tu med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsgoms pa la yid gtad de mnyam par gzhag go /de nas sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ snying gi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ yi ge hrīḥbasgoms pa'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis/ bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ phyir 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje rang la 'jug par bsam zhing*/

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla bar bya'o// phreng ba'i mdo 'dzin nas/ mdo 'dzin la ma slebs kyi bar du tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bzla/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag drug cu ste/ des las kyi tshogs ji skad bshad pa rnams 'grub la/ byang chub bsgrub pa la ni tshad med do// de nas bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas su bsngos nas/ spyod lam thams cad lha'i nga rgyal gyis bya'o// rang dang gzhan gyi nad kyi zug rngu sel bar 'dod pas/ gang na ba'i sar/ zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥ'i yi ge las/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas/ zug rngu thams cad bsal zhing*/ bde bas gang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas/ yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags par bya'o// sngags kyi chus bdag dang gzhan la phan gdags par 'dod na/ chu gtsang ma'i nang du/ pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa'i lte bar hrīḥ 'dab ma rnams la rim pa bzhin yi ge drug pa bkod nas/ de rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ snod yongs su gang bar bsam zhing*/ yi ge drug pas mngon par bsngags pa'i chu 'thungs pa dang*/ bkrus pas nad dang*/ zug rngu sel bar bya ba'o// nyal ba'i tshe stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal zhing*/ ldang ba'i tshe lha'i nga rgyal gyis ldang bar bya'o// 'di'i rnal 'byor gyis rtag tu gnas na/ gnas skabs su nad dang sdug bsngal zhi zhing*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs nas mthar byang chub 'grub pa nyid do// bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ chos rje sa skya pa'i gsung bzhin/ 'phags pas rgya'i yul du yi ger bkod pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
